title: Using the combined UNION ALL report of (1) per-migration-status instance me
question: Using the combined UNION ALL report of (1) per-migration-status instance memory statistics and (2) per-VM-state instance root disk statistics as an inner CTE, list only the rows whose avg_value is greater than the overall average avg_value for the same “reason”, and show the category, avg_value, variance_value, stddev_value, range_value, and reason. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH report AS (
  SELECT 'memory' AS category,
         m.status AS reason,
         AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_value,
         VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_value,
         STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS stddev_value,
         MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS range_value
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  GROUP BY m.status
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'root_disk' AS category,
         i.vm_state AS reason,
         AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_value,
         VARIANCE(i.root_gb) AS variance_value,
         STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS stddev_value,
         MAX(i.root_gb) - MIN(i.root_gb) AS range_value
  FROM instances i
  GROUP BY i.vm_state
),
reason_avg AS (
  SELECT reason, AVG(avg_value) AS overall_avg
  FROM report
  GROUP BY reason
)
SELECT r.category, r.avg_value, r.variance_value, r.stddev_value, r.range_value, r.reason
FROM report r
JOIN reason_avg a ON a.reason = r.reason
WHERE r.avg_value > a.overall_avg;
